text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О and I are going to meet at
a shrine
to welcome in the new year. This
marks her
advance to senior racer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She still hasn't arrived, but then I hear a
familiar
voice coming from the main
building.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! Ask something of the
gods?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I am accustomed to being worshipped, but the other way around? Well...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
If you insist, I shall come up with
something.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hear me, gods. Why not ask me for a favor, hm?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О
choice_data_list: Opera O, move over to the side, please.

text_block_list.text: The side?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see. Standing at the center makes
it seem as
though the masses have come
to pray to me
instead.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
We hurriedly move to a spot away from
the
center...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I must say, it's a perplexing task to think
of a wish
the Overlord might ask.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Alas, what could one who has
everything, as I do,
possibly desire?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I could demand to be initiated as the
Centurial
Overlord, but that is, as you'd
expect... asking a
lot.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Have you any ideas?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: And make sure they are overlordly!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
An overlordly desire. If I had to say
anything, it
would be...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: A title change to Demon Lord.

text_block_list.text:
Ahh, an imperial feast! I will ask the
gods to
prepare an assortment of the
most lavish
delicacies!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Whooosh!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa! My body is moving on its own!
Are the
gods guiding me?!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Come along, Trainer! Quickly!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: She leads me to...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A ramen shop? And a rather run down
one at that.
But a restaurant of Chinese
origin all the same.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
The roots are identical, so I will dine in
the spirit
of the Qing dynasty rulers. In
what manner should
I ask...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Master, I request "the works," if you
please. This
is the most affluent, I
assume.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And add gyoza and fried rice as
toppings for
good measure!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Now that is what I call a New Year's special—the Overlord ramen forte!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
A vocational change! Yes, rather than
the path of
the Centurial Overlord, the
path of the Demon
Lord is also on the
table.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How interesting... A new year is the best
time to
try new things, and thus, to the
dark side I turn.
Behold, I am the Demon
Lord! Heavens, cower
before me!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Flash! Rumble, rumble!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha! Come, torrential
downpour! Drench
all of humanity, all of
Umamusume kind!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Ohh! This play tickles far more than I
expected! I
feel a level of greatness
never before
experienced!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Restore the ruling system of old! Veni,
vidi, vici...
and the like, yes?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Of course! It is time to reclaim control
from the
modern-day statesmen.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
President, there is a matter we must
discuss. It
concerns the organizational
structure of this
academy.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I believe it's about time we do away with
these
democratically elected leaders
and restore the
right of rule to kings.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
I was unaware that Академия Тайсен was
ever a
monarchy...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Listen well. Rule under a king has its
superior
points. Such as...
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Opera O eats every last bite of the extra
large
ramen put in front of her. She's full
of energy!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Acting like a demon lord seems to have
made
Opera O stronger in every way.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Т.М. Опера О elegantly lays out her
argument.
This exchange with Symboli
Rudolf appears to
have expanded her
knowledge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
